text:
jordana: Heads up — spotted a weird failure in the sampleapp when running the rerank e2e. Batch helper built a batch of embeddings (claimed model open-embed-lite-512) and the rerank endpoint returned a dim_mismatch.

mike: Do we have the exact server error? Could be model alias pinning.

jordana: Server replied with: {error: "dim_mismatch", got:512, expected:768, help:"use model open-embed-lite-768 or send X-Embedding-Dim"} (sanitized). Payload used field name `vector` in the body.

sam: A few things colliding here: SDK field-name variance (`vector` vs `embedding` vs `embeddings`), model alias pinning, and our retrier behavior. I think the batch helper also tries to auto-chunk very large batches which might run through a different code path that uses a quantized pipeline.

lina: Confirmed parity issue: Node runtime contains a silent pad-to-expected-length behavior; Python and Ruby do not. That explains why some integrations never fail. We need a spec: failing fast in all SDKs unless opt-in pad_mode is set.

mike: Agreed. Proposals: (1) batch helper: validate vector length against model.metadata.embedding_dim before enqueueing, (2) expose a wrapper normalize_embedding_field(body) that maps `vector`/`embedding`/`embeddings` to canonical `embedding`/`embeddings`, (3) add Idempotency-Key for batch calls and make retrier only retry non-accepted failures (i.e., on 5xx or network errors, not on ambiguous timeouts without server ack).

jordana: Also encountered dup scoring when our test harness retried a batch after a socket timeout. Server accepted both on replays. We should set idempotency semantics and maybe return 202+location for long-running reranks so clients poll instead of blind retries.

sam: Backend follow-ups: add optional header X-Embedding-Dim so the service can route to a 512-capable reranker, and add friendly error payload listing candidate model aliases and a curl example. Example: 
``` 
curl -X POST "/rerank" -H "X-Embedding-Dim: 512" -d '{"requests":[...],"model":"open-embed-lite-512"}'
``` 
This helps clients that intentionally send quantized vectors.

lina: For SDK parity, recommended default behavior: validate and raise a DimensionError; provide an opt-in transformer: pad_mode=(pad|trim|fail) with explicit logs when transformation happens. Also default to sending Idempotency-Key: uuid4().

mike: Add a tiny change to devex sampleapp: compatibility shim that normalizes field names and checks dims, and a debug mode that prints model.metadata.embedding_dim at startup. Add a precommit check (vector-shape-lint) that runs on changed files to detect embedding fixtures > 2KB or mismatched dims in tests.

jordana: I'll open a PR for sampleapp with: normalize shim + dim validator + a failing integration test that asserts dim_mismatch payload shape. Test will also verify that when X-Embedding-Dim is provided, server suggests candidate models.

sam: Also suggest SDK-level change: when a request times out client-side, don't immediately retry; instead attach X-Retry-Reason: timeout and include Idempotency-Key so server can dedupe. The retrier should backoff with jitter and consult status codes (don't retry on 4xx).

lina: UX nit: unify response field names across SDKs. Public spec: response.single => `embedding`, response.batch => `embeddings`. SDKs should provide backwards-compatible accessors (e.g., get_embedding()).

mike: Ops asks: emit metric dim_mismatch_count with tags {model_alias, client_declared_dim, server_expected_dim} and add a trace event when pad_mode mutates a vector. That will help SRE track sources of silent mutation.

jordana: devx-bot linked ticket DEVEX-3222: "embed/rerank: dim validation, idempotency, field-name normalization". I'll attach the failing test logs.

devx-bot: Task DEVEX-3222 created and assigned to @devex. See https://tracker.redwood/devex/3222.

sam: Small proto for improved error payload the server should return when dims mismatch: 
``` 
{
  "error": "dim_mismatch",
  "got": "512",
  "expected": "768",
  "candidates": ["open-embed-lite-768","open-embed-xl-768"],
  "help": "Set X-Embedding-Dim: 512 or pick a compatible model. Example: curl ..."
}
``` 
This is machine-readable and gives SDKs clear guidance.

lina: I'll draft the SDK spec doc and a change list for Node/Python/Go. Plan: small patch release with breaking-behavior flag off by default for 2 weeks, then flip on by default after telemetry.

mike: One more thing: batch helper should include per-item ids and server should accept idempotent dedupe by ids within the same Idempotency-Key window. That way if the client retries, server can identify duplicates even if payload ordering changes.

jordana: Good call. I'll include that in the PR: each request requires `id` and we add Idempotency-Key header. Test will assert duplicate ids under same key are deduped.

devx-bot: Follow-up tasks added: DEVEX-3223 (SDK spec), DEVEX-3224 (server header + error payload), DEVEX-3225 (sampleapp tests).

mike: Thanks all. Let's keep the compatibility shim in sampleapp until SDKs land. After SDK releases, remove shim and update docs.

jordana: Resolving for now; will link PRs when ready.

lina: Ping me for SDK review. :thumbsup:

sam: Closing loop on server changes; will post when deployed to staging.

mike: :rocket:
